【In the end】
Thank you for playing this game. As a doujin type of game circle, it was a great learning experience for me to sell this game on Steam for the first time. I will never forget it. I am grateful to everyone who picked up the game, and I hope it will be a game you will remember for the rest of your life!

By the time we completed this game using "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289520/SHMUP_Creator/]SHMUP Creator[/url]", which we miraculously came across after three aborted attempts, more than four years had passed since the start of production.Thanks to “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289520/SHMUP_Creator/]SHMUP Creator[/url]” and “bulo studio” who produced it, we are able to see the light of day in this way. Without SHMUP Creator, this work would not have been born!
We will continue to produce sexy games as ever, so please continue to support us at Circle Marumelon.

notes.title: Updated 1.4
notes.notes:
・Support for SteamDeck
・After the second defeat of the last boss, the true end can be reached by selecting “Launch a missile” in the event.

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Changes and modifications
・We made it possible to warp to the second round when the conditions are met.
※How to do it?
From the start of the 1st stage, head to the middle boss without killing any Rola.
[previewyoutube=e5VekHtH5xk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

・Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Changes and modifications
・Fixed bullet speed, bullet size, and placement of some enemies.
・The HP and attack patterns of some bosses have been changed.
・Some weapons can now fire continuously when the shot button is held down.
・The player's movement speed and bullet speed have been increased.
・Fixed the expression of the background.
・Fixed the expression of enemy is defeated.
